summary: DROP CANDIDATE: $60 posted, no gateway. Added fees 60-70, 50A, sewer, pull-through, laundry, showers, booking by phone. Confirmed 242 sites. Website should move to sunvalleycampground.com.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE, PRICE: the operator's 2026 rate is $60 a night for an RV ('Campsite', under 'Tent & Short-Term Sites'), $70 holidays. Over US$50, with no gateway within 40 km (Columbus 112 km). Good Sam: stored false. The only under-$50 rates are tent: with electric $45, primitive $40.

DROP CANDIDATE, LONG-STAY TEST 4: every numbered site 1-242 is priced under seasonal (Interior 15-120, Exterior 1-14 and 138-192, Pull Thru 45-63, Moderate 121-136, Deluxe 137, 193-242) or 12-month residential (87-137, 138-181, 193-242 at $410-450 a month). No site range is set aside for nightly use; 'our campsite availability is very limited', and Reservation terms require a lease at check-in. The nightly-site share can't be shown to reach 1 in 10. Test 2 is met only on the posted $60.
WEBSITE: replace the directory ohiocamper link with https://sunvalleycampground.com/ (operator's own; phone 419-648-2235 matches). Google 4.2 from 315 reviews.

WATERFRONT LEAD: the operator's map draws rows 138-181 along the Little Auglaize River, which stored 'not waterfront' doesn't reflect. Those rows are seasonal and residential, and I didn't plot them. Worth a look only if the park stays.

SEASON: rates page gives 'Seasonal Sites (April - October)' and 12-month residential contracts; stored 04-15/10-31 (derived from the note) is neither stated nor contradicted by the operator's pages, so the field stays, and the note's copy of it is dropped as redundant.
